summary: All 51 requirements are implemented and traced; the project compiles. 12 points the requirements leave open are recorded below, each with the resolution used.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn are natural numbers but -1 is specified for 'none'
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 declare cstc and cdyn natural numbers and LRE-DM5/OP3/OP4 make -1 mean 'no obstacle'; the Java profile maps int to nat, which cannot be negative.
issues.fix_directive: Resolved: sentinel LreConstants.NO_OBSTACLE = 0; ObstacleRegister.put rejects index 0, so register indices start at 1. No guard tests the sentinel; it only reaches the sensor functions, which return their 'no obstacle' defaults for it.

issues.title: Value of the 'safe large distance'
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says odist/hdist/vdist return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists, without a value.
issues.fix_directive: Chose LreConstants.SAFE_LARGE_DIST = 1000000.0 m (integral, so not changed by the model's rounding of constants).

issues.title: No-dynamic-obstacle defaults for CalcCPA: zero (DM5) or large distance (OP5)
issues.raw: LRE-DM5: field accessors nsRelDist/ewRelDist return zero when no obstacle exists. LRE-OP5: the Sensor returns 'zero-velocity and large-distance defaults'. With zero relative distances a naive CPA gives cda = 0 and tcpa = 0, i.e. a spurious collision.
issues.fix_directive: Kept DM5's zero accessors. CalcCPA adds (hdist(cdyn) - sqrt(ns^2 + ew^2)) to cda: exactly 0 for a registered obstacle, SAFE_LARGE_DIST when there is none, so no spurious CAM.

issues.title: CPA formula: horizontal plane, closing velocity, epsilon
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 does not give the formula for cda and tcpa.
issues.fix_directive: Horizontal plane only (the four accessors the Sensor provides). Closing velocity w = AUV velocity - obstacle velocity, since a static obstacle has zero velocity (ground frame). tcpa = (p.w)/(|w|^2 + CPA_EPSILON); cda = |p - w*tcpa|. CPA_EPSILON = 0.000001 avoids division by zero (no NaN). The model's constants interface rounds CPA_EPSILON up to 1, so the model's cda/tcpa values differ numerically from Java's; no guard compares against CPA_EPSILON directly.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: 0 m/s (FR3) versus 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: system_description.txt: HCM 'Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)'. LRE-FR3: 'On entering HCM, the LRE advises a velocity of 0 m/s'.
issues.fix_directive: Followed the requirement: every transition into HCM issues advVel(0.0).

issues.title: Transition priority within MOM and HCM
issues.raw: All LRE-Beh requirements have the same priority (8); the order of overlapping transitions is not given.
issues.fix_directive: Order: reqOCM (operator override, first in MOM, HCM and CAM), then inOpez -> OCM, then collision course -> CAM, then endTask/reqHCM, then the static-obstacle HCM entries. Every branch below a guard-only branch conjoins the negation of that guard. Beh11 (vvel >= 1 and vdist <= staticObsVertDist) is placed before Beh10 (vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist): with the default thresholds equal, Beh10 subsumes Beh11, so the reverse order would make Beh11 a dead transition. Consequence: an endTask or reqHCM received while in OPEZ or on a collision course is not taken; the safety transition is taken instead.

issues.title: LRE-DC1 'no duplicate transitions for the same source mode and trigger event'
issues.raw: MOM has five trigger-less transitions (Beh5, Beh8, Beh9, Beh10, Beh11), HCM three (Beh13, Beh14, Beh16), as the requirements demand.
issues.fix_directive: Read DC1 as: one transition per Beh requirement and no two transitions on the same input event from the same mode. That holds; the trigger-less transitions are distinguished by their guards.

issues.title: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA obtain the closest indices from the Sensor
issues.raw: LRE-OP2 says CheckOPEZ uses the index computed by CalcCStc; OP5 says CalcCPA uses cdyn. The operation profile only allows sensor calls and the operation's own fields in compute().
issues.fix_directive: CheckOPEZ calls sensor.closestStaticIndex() and CalcCPA calls sensor.closestDynamicIndex(): the same functions CalcCStc and CalcCDyn call, so within a cycle they get the same index.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1: 'vvel is the rate of climb'. LRE-Beh11: 'vvel is at or above 1 m/s'.
issues.fix_directive: vvel = rateOfClimb (signed), so Beh11 fires only when climbing at >= 1 m/s, not when descending fast. Vertical proximity at any speed is still covered by Beh10.

issues.title: CAM evasive manoeuvre has no specified output
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: in CAM 'the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres'; no velocity or heading is given, and LRE-DM7 allows only advVel and advHdng.
issues.fix_directive: Entering CAM issues no output. The manoeuvre is left to the autopilot; CAM ends on reqOCM or when cda >= minSafeDist (advVel(0)).

issues.title: Initial sensor readings and advised values
issues.raw: No requirement gives values before the first sensor reading or the first advice.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor raw readings start at 0.0 (depth 0 puts the AUV in OPEZ, so reqMOM is refused until a real depth arrives); Actuator advised velocity and heading start at 0.0.

issues.title: Literal thresholds and naming
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4/Beh9/Beh11 give literal thresholds of 1; LRE-DM2 names obstacle fields in snake_case.
issues.fix_directive: Literal 1.0 used where the requirement gives a number (not tied to minSafeDist). Obstacle components keep the requirement's snake_case names, so they cannot collide with the Sensor accessors nsRelDist etc. step(null) means a cycle with no operator input. On a distance tie, closestStaticIndex/closestDynamicIndex return the lowest index.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, verifiers). No issue blocks it.
